title: Who will win the men's javelin throw gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
background: The 2026 Commonwealth Games are scheduled to take place in Glasgow, Scotland.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official Commonwealth Games results or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the gold medallist in the 2026 men's javelin throw final. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the athlete declared the gold medallist at the conclusion of the final. Subsequent medal reallocations will not affect resolution. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The gold medallist's full name.
